visual.description: Very dark near-black background used for the overall page and modal overlay blur.
White background used for the newsletter modal/dialog panel.
Pure black used for the 'Accept All Cookies' CTA button.
Dark near-black used for modal heading text 'JOIN THE OFF-WHITE™ COMMUNITY'.
Dark gray used for body copy text within the modal and cookie notice.
White text label on the black primary action button.
Light gray used for the email input field border and checkbox outlines.
Very light gray/off-white background of the email input field.
Vibrant orange-red used in the 'I X OW' poster visible in the background hero image, representing the Off-White brand accent color.
Medium gray used for placeholder text in the email input field.
Dark gray with underline used for the 'Privacy Policy' hyperlink within the consent text.
Light gray background of the cookie consent banner at the bottom of the screen.
